# developer.paypal.com documentation — Api — Orders

> 13 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Api under Orders. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Orders

- [v2](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2): Copy for LLMView as MarkdownAPI Reference OverviewOrders v2API v2API v2SDKorders7 endpointsPOSTCreate order/v2/checkout/ordersCreates an order.GETShow order…
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/orders-authorize): Authorizes payment for an order. To successfully authorize payment for an order, the buyer must first approve the order or a valid payment_source must be provided in the request.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/orders-capture): Captures payment for an order. To successfully capture payment for an order, the buyer must first approve the order or a valid payment_source must be provided in the request.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/orders-patch): Updates an order with a `CREATED` or `APPROVED` status. You cannot update an order with the `COMPLETED` status.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/orders-create): Creates an order. Merchants and partners can add Level 2 and 3 data to payments to reduce risk and payment processing costs.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/orders-get): Shows details for an order, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/orders-confirm): Payer confirms their intent to pay for the the Order with the given payment source.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/orders-track-create): Adds tracking information for an Order.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/orders-trackers-patch): Updates or cancels the tracking information for a PayPal order, by ID. Updatable attributes or objects:
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/server-callback): The documentation for this 'endpoint' is different from the other endpoints under v2 Orders. For this endpoint the role of client and server is reversed.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/certs-get): Returns the public X.509 certificate (PEM-encoded) for the specified certificate id. Merchants use this certificate to verify the signature of PayPal callback requests.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/definitions/processor_response): The processor response information for payment requests, such as direct credit card transactions.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2/error-messages): Errors are listed by endpoint and then by error name.
